name: write
title: Change a graph
description: Change a task graph: merge in tasks and dependencies, edit one task, or remove edges. Pick with `op`. Nothing here deletes — emptying a graph is `reset`.

op.description: plan: add or change tasks and dependencies — MERGES, never deletes, so a new plan needs no wipe (send `tasks`, `edges` or `title`). update: one task’s status or fields (needs `key`). unlink: remove dependency edges, keeping the tasks (needs `edges`). Emptying or deleting a whole graph is `reset`, not here.

new_graph.description: Start a separate graph instead of merging. Ignored when `graph` is given.

title.description: Names the GRAPH (op=plan). Renaming a task is `task_title`.

tasks.description: Tasks to create or update, matched by key.

title.description: Short imperative title. Kept whole; shortened to 80 chars where it repeats.

status.description: Omitted leaves an existing task’s status alone.
Start, finish, reopen or cancel a task. Reopening does not reopen its dependents.

task_title.description: Renames the task. Separate from `title`, which renames the graph.
